'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Myanmar civil war (2021–present)|Myanmar civil war]]
**[[Operation 1027]]
***[[Battle of Laukkai]]
****The [[Myanmar National Democratic Alliance Army|MNDAA]] gain full control of [[Laukkai]], capital of the [[Kokang Self-Administered Zone]], following the mass surrender of the last [[State Administration Council|junta]] [[Tatmadaw|forces]] and officials within the city. *[[Iraqi conflict]]
**[[Attacks on U.S. bases in Iraq, Jordan, and Syria (2023–present)#U.S. response|U.S. drone strikes in Iraq and Syria]]
***[[Prime Minister of Iraq|Prime Minister]] of [[Iraq]] [[Mohammed Shia' Al Sudani]] announces that the Iraqi government is beginning the process to remove the U.S.-led international military coalition from the country after a U.S. drone strike in [[Baghdad]] yesterday killed a militia leader. *[[Korean conflict]]
**[[North Korea]] fires 200 [[artillery]] shells near [[South Korea]]'s [[Yeonpyeongdo|Yeonpyeong Island]], prompting [[emergency evacuation|evacuations]]. [https://www.cnbc.com/2024/01/05/south-korea-evacuates-yeonpyeong-island-after-pyongyang-provocation.html (CNBC)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 Noto earthquake]]
**The death toll from the [[Richter scale|magnitude]] 7.6 [[list of earthquakes in Japan|earthquake]] in the [[Noto Peninsula]] in [[Ishikawa Prefecture]], [[Japan]], on January 1, increases to 94 people. At least 222 others are still missing. [https://apnews.com/article/earthquake-rescue-ishikawa-japan-disaster-missing-coastline-7063cef9950f59b9702a6fc8364ff363 (AP)]
*[[Alaska Airlines Flight 1282]]
**An [[Alaska Airlines]] [[Boeing 737 Max 9]] aircraft loses a door section of its [[fuselage]] mid-air and makes an [[emergency landing]] in [[Portland, Oregon|Portland]], [[Oregon]], [[United States]], with no major injuries reported.  The [[Federal Aviation Administration]] subsequently orders a temporary grounding of all 737 Max 9 aircraft in response to the incident. [https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2024/jan/06/alaska-airlines-grounds-boeing-737-max-9-planes-after-mid-air-window-blowout (''The Guardian'')] [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-67899564 (BBC News)] [https://www.cnn.com/2024/01/06/us/alaska-airlines-window-landing/index.html (CNN)]
*[[2024 Cicalengka station railway collision]]
**Two [[passenger train]]s [[train wreck|collide]] near [[Cicalengka railway station]] in [[Bandung Regency]], [[West Java]], [[Indonesia]], killing at least four people and injuring several others. [https://apnews.com/article/indonesia-train-collision-java-b9357f6ef81dd15695ba43fa5f7bb47d (AP)]
